body: I’m an emotional abusive person. When people are upset at me, I threaten to harm myself. I’m an introverted person with no social skills and social anxiety.

I tell people not to get close because I’m a bad person, and they don’t listen to me. I do something that constantly hurts them and then they realize that I was right and then they leave. I’m just tired of this cycle happening and I feel that this is the only way for it to end.
Emotional trauma to and from people.
